title: athyrium majus
intro: Athyrium majus, commonly known as the American lady fern, is a type of plant that belongs to the Athyrium genus of ferns. The health benefits of Athyrium majus include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as coughs, colds, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium majus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
